clips.h3_prompt: Use Picture 1 only as the identity reference for the single character LLL-MAIN-001 and Picture 2 only as the forest-lake environment reference. In a fixed 9:16 medium-wide shot, exactly one red-haired mechanical dragon girl stands still near the existing lake space, keeping her red-white-black mechanical armor, cyan functional accents, mechanical claw feet and one long segmented mechanical dragon tail unchanged. A narrow patch of reflected color on the lake shifts once toward frame-left. Her eyes move first, then her head turns slightly left, and her shoulders make a small believable feint toward that direction while both claw feet remain planted. She stops in the feint with a restrained competitive half-smile. Keep the camera, framing, lighting and weather unchanged; preserve clean linework, soft light and the original character design.

Keep exactly one character, preserve her face, red hair, body proportions, red-white-black armor, cyan accents, claw feet and tail structure; do not change the camera, lighting, weather or scene layout.
